description: Reaction bar for a comment showing each grouped emoji reaction with its count and highlighting the current user's own reactions. An add button opens a TmReactionPicker, and toggling a reaction raises OnReactionToggled.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id used for active reaction styling.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether the reaction bar is disabled.

parameters.name: OnReactionToggled
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a reaction value is toggled.

parameters.name: PickerOpenChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the picker open state changes.
